verdict.rationale: The DGX B200 ships with a management and software ecosystem (health monitoring, Mission Control, Redfish/IPMI interfaces), so an official MCP server is a plausible capability and the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence documents an NVIDIA MCP server for B200 or DGX. The llms.txt documentation files for AI user agents are an adjacent docs feature, not an MCP server agents can connect to.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
